🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO'S TARIFFS BITE: ASIAN IMPORTS COLLAPSE 32.5%</u>

Mexico's tariffs on countries without free-trade deals are reshaping its trade map: imports from Taiwan, China and Brazil fell 32.5% in the first half of 2026, and the 1,463 taxed product lines dropped from $18.4B to $14.4B (-21.7%), per Economy Ministry data. Autoparts imports alone fell nearly 40% — $909M less — as the policy pushes to rebuild national industry, El Financiero reports.

🇲🇽📊 <u>13.5 MILLION MEXICANS LIFTED OUT OF POVERTY IN 6 YEARS</u>

In her second annual report, Sheinbaum underlined the number behind the Fourth Transformation: 13.5 million Mexicans out of poverty between 2018 and 2024, according to INEGI — driven, she said, by rising minimum wages, social programs now written into the constitution, and record public investment. She called it "a figure that shook the world."

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>PEMEX DEBT DOWN $20 BILLION AS MEXICO ELECTRIFIES</u>

Pemex has cut its debt by $20 billion while the state brings electricity to more than 600,000 people across 13,000 remote communities, Sheinbaum said — part of a plan to reach 99.9% electrification by 2030 and lift renewables from 24% to 38% of the grid. She framed it as energy sovereignty: refineries and the power grid rebuilt by the state, not sold off.

🇲🇽🗳️ <u>MEXICO OPENS DRIVE TO RENEW 5.4M VOTER IDs FOR 2027</u>

Mexico's INE launched a six-month campaign — through March 15, 2027 — to renew 5.4 million voter credentials expiring this year, ahead of the June 2027 midterms, with home visits and outreach in Indigenous and Afro-Mexican languages. The electoral roll already covers 97.68% of eligible citizens.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>US WANTS 10 MEXICAN OFFICIALS — AND SHOWS NO EVIDENCE</u>

Washington asked Mexico to detain 10 officials for extradition — including Sinaloa governor Rubén Rocha Moya — yet has handed over no proof, Sheinbaum said, noting the US line is simply that it "wouldn't have to." When Mexico requests an extradition, she pointed out, US courts demand far more. Mexico's Foreign Ministry has formally asked for the evidence and is still waiting.
